managerPlaneToolDescription: Manager Plane Tool is a web application for the efficient management of technology inventories through customisable visual floor plans. It allows users to create zones, add devices with detailed information, and assign them to precise locations using coordinates. Built with React, JavaScript, TailwindCSS, and Konva.js, it offers drawing tools, shape creation, a layer system, device categorisation, and an intuitive drag-and-drop interface. Development challenges included implementing a precise coordinate system, optimising rendering, and managing complex state.
deployChatDescription: Deploy-Chat is a project with retro vibes and a dev essence: a chat platform designed for work teams, featuring terminal-style themes, syntax highlighting, integrated AI, and E2E encryption. Built with React 19 + Vite, Supabase, and TailwindCSS, it offers real-time chat, OAuth authentication, ES/EN internationalisation, notes, search, and event scheduling. The development involved learning about row-level security, advanced state management with custom hooks, real-time communication optimisation, encryption, and a scalable architecture.
toolFrameDescription: Tool Frame is a modern web application for managing and discovering general development tools. It allows users to add and remove tools, with real-time intelligent search, category filtering, and preview functionality. Built with React 18, Vite, and TailwindCSS, it features ES/EN internationalisation, a responsive design, data persistence using LocalStorage, and a modern UI with smooth animations.
